subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured model `input` accept audio/video as provider metadata while runtime supports only text/image, or should OpenClaw reject unsupported modalities from configured chat models before deployment?
rationale: Both paths have compatibility consequences: current schema/types/tests preserve audio/video metadata, while the requested guardrail wants invalid or unsupported combinations to fail early.

options.title: Accept Metadata Plus Guardrails
options.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata, but add semantic checks and clear diagnostics when a runtime path cannot use those modalities.

options.title: Reject Unsupported Inputs
options.body: Tighten validation to reject unsupported configured model inputs and add any needed doctor migration or override path for existing configs.

options.title: Defer Contract Change
options.body: Leave current acceptance/projection behavior until the related media-output and fallback-policy issues settle the broader capability model.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata Plus Guardrails
recommendation.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata, but add semantic checks and clear diagnostics when a runtime path cannot use those modalities.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and issue history make steipete the clearest routing candidate for the config/provider capability contract decision.
